body:
Keep the pesticide trial jars sealed until the spray plot is dry. The neighbor's calves got into the treated rows and have not eaten since; the dog is still in the yard.

I kept one copy for myself. The trial crew promised to come for the other jars and never did.

The label on the lid is the only part of that week I trusted.
title: The jars stay sealed
